counterhypotheses.counterhypothesis: A universal consume-bound provenance primitive overgeneralizes heterogeneous boundaries; branch-local typed guards are simpler and equally safe.
counterhypotheses.supporting_evidence: No external source in this run establishes that one universal contract is superior; SLSA only supports consumer-side verification as a pattern.
counterhypotheses.discriminator: Matched common fault matrix: universal CBPC vs branch-local guards; compare fail-closed coverage, false rejects, recovery equivalence, latency, complexity and implementation defects.

counterhypotheses.counterhypothesis: If reward folds can only execute at machine-enforced frozen checkpoints with terminal writers excluded, explicit source-frontier identity adds no safety value.
counterhypotheses.supporting_evidence: Internal current gap is a concurrency gap, not evidence that concurrency must exist; external transaction systems show multiple ways to coordinate position/output.
counterhypotheses.discriminator: Prove writer exclusion/topology mechanically, then run concurrent-DONE attempts; if impossible by construction, compare simpler frozen-checkpoint fold against explicit frontier design.

counterhypotheses.counterhypothesis: System receipts, behavior, explicit Clay state and LoopDynamicsReadout already contain all useful control information; LCOP adds model-specific fragility and cost.
counterhypotheses.supporting_evidence: 2025-2026 causal probing work shows completeness/selectivity tradeoffs, task-format confounds and large knowledge-action gaps.
counterhypotheses.discriminator: Incremental-value benchmark: existing readouts vs existing+LCOP on held-out/OOD prediction, intervention utility, calibration, latency and resource cost.

counterhypotheses.counterhypothesis: Putative model-native workspace signatures are method/model-specific and redundant with explicit ClayGWT; adding a dual-workspace control layer causes overcoupling without outcome gain.
counterhypotheses.supporting_evidence: External workspace evidence is architecture/model specific; no source proves complementarity with an explicit external GWT controller.
counterhypotheses.discriminator: Native workspace intact/lesion/steer x ClayGWT truthful/shuffled/no-reentry factorial with additive/common-driver controls and overcoupling readouts.

counterhypotheses.counterhypothesis: Prompt-only persona plus explicit immutable identity rules is enough; persistent factorized personality creates unnecessary drift surfaces.
counterhypotheses.supporting_evidence: Personality measurements are unstable, but that instability could argue against persistent personality state rather than for factorization.
counterhypotheses.discriminator: Long-horizon restart/OOD comparison: prompt-only persona vs one vector vs factorized state on warranted adaptation, unwanted drift, continuity, calibration, resources and outcome quality.

counterhypotheses.counterhypothesis: For selected probes/interventions, latent control survives quantization/build changes within practical tolerance, so full revalidation after every build is wasteful.
counterhypotheses.supporting_evidence: Some quantization methods preserve task performance well and some representation features transfer across model scales; direct Frank-relevant latent-transfer evidence is missing.
counterhypotheses.discriminator: Pre/post exact-build matched probe calibration, causal selectivity, steering efficacy and OOD transfer. Promote per-probe transfer certificates only when supported.

counterhypotheses.counterhypothesis: Fixed or event-driven recurrence thresholds capture nearly all utility with lower instability and observability cost.
counterhypotheses.supporting_evidence: Current project evidence does not establish universal benefit; additional compute can mimic mechanism improvement.
counterhypotheses.discriminator: Cost-matched fixed vs event-driven vs adaptive recurrence on automatic/complex/OOD tasks with residual-pressure and false-halt/overthinking metrics.

counterhypotheses.counterhypothesis: Pairwise/factorized alternatives preserve all decision-relevant uncertainty; hypergraph/higher-order state adds complexity without causal gain.
counterhypotheses.supporting_evidence: Prior hypofusion already found classes with exact pairwise reductions; no new evidence overturns that bound.
counterhypotheses.discriminator: Pairwise baseline vs Hyperposition on higher-order synthetic + real ambiguous latent/route cases, matched for memory/latency, using decision regret and calibration.

counterhypotheses.counterhypothesis: The installed Ubuntu SQLite build contains a relevant backport or Frank topology makes WAL-reset trigger conditions unreachable.
counterhypotheses.supporting_evidence: Upstream documents backports for some old branches, so version number alone cannot rule a fix in or out.
counterhypotheses.discriminator: Exact loaded-object/source provenance plus targeted topology/fault test or machine-checked single-connection/no-concurrent-checkpoint proof.
